The PA-46-600TP is a derivative product from the PA-46-500TP.
As such, the regulations that were applicable to the basic PA-46-500TP that are not affected by the changed product (PA-46-600TP) remain at the original amendment levels.
Those regulations that are affected by the change are FAR 23, effective February 1, 1965, as amended by 14 CFR Part 23 Amendment 23-62, effective January 31, 2012
